svg.text: a lookup table P (GPT-2, BERT): row 137 exists, row 2049 does not
sinusoidal: the same stamp from a fixed function — defined everywhere,
but the weights were never trained past the lengths seen
ALiBi: subtract slope × distance from the logit; nothing stored or looked up
Shaw 2018 / T5: a learned (or bucketed) bias per distance
RoPE: stamp the absolute time on q and on k — as a rotation. The dot product keeps only the angle between them.
a property of rotations, not learned
fast hands resolve neighbours; slow hands reach far;
a slow hand that never completed a turn in training
